A family confectionery on Aischylou Street with baklava, cakes and cookies made in the back. On Google, 4.9 stars from 107 reviews.

Sweets

What is on the counter

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Traditional sweets

Baklava, kataifi and old school sweets. Guests call the place an authentic Cypriot confectionery.

Cakes to order

Cream cake and orange cake, and birthday cakes made to your own idea, as one family describes.

Vasilopita and flaounes

One guest calls both their vasilopita and their flaounes delicious.

Savoury and coffee

Olive cake, cookies and Cypriot coffee. Guests mention frappé too.

Baklava

Photo from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from Google reviews and the shop's Facebook page.

Made in the back

A family business: guests write that you can see the family making the sweets on the spot.

Tables inside

A calm room with plenty of space, white cabinets and old city photos on the wall.

Order online

The Facebook page links to Wolt and Foody for orders.

Since 1948

One of the oldest confectioneries in the heart of old Nicosia, as the shop writes itself. Open Monday to Saturday from 7 in the morning.

What guests say

Three of 107 Google reviews, 100 of them with five stars.

“My favourite family-run confectionery in Nicosia! Everything tastes authentic, fresh, and made with care. Their vasilopita are delicious, and so are their flaounes :)”

Google review
“Very very delicious cakes. We were grateful to stumble across this authentic cake shop. Big variety of cakes. Staff very nice. Cosy and calm inside.”

Google review
“Our daughter had an idea for her birthday cake so we went to Melissa pastry shop the people there was very helpful. We showed them what we wanted. The Cake it was fantastic and very delicious. Thank you guys for your creative powers:)))”
